concerns.text: Task T018 (Contract Test for Data Schema) is scheduled before the data file it validates (`data/processed/knots_cleaned.csv`) is produced by Task T014. This violates the producer‑before‑consumer rule.

Tasks T041a (Model Fitting), T041b (Residual Analysis Module), T041c (Plotting Module), and T041d (Model Reporting Module) are placed in the Foundational phase but depend on the cleaned dataset generated later (e.g., by T014 and T012). They should be moved to a later phase after data ingestion.

User Story 3 tasks (T041a‑d) are not independently shippable because they require the outputs of User Story 1 (download & parse) and User Story 2 (data quality). This breaks the independent implementation requirement for US‑grouped tasks.

Task T028 (Residual Analysis Execution) is listed under Phase 2 but its description notes it was moved to Phase 4 in execution order, yet it remains in the Phase 2 block, creating a minor ordering inconsistency.
